Achiever.name: Achiever
Achiever.tagline: High stamina, tireless work ethic, and satisfaction in completing tangible goals.
Achiever.description: You possess an intrinsic drive to accomplish tasks each day. You feel a constant need for tangible achievement and find deep fulfillment in productivity, high stamina, and relentless forward progress.
Achiever.action_tip: Establish clear daily milestones and celebrate completed objectives before diving into the next project.
Achiever.shadow: Colleagues can read your constant drive as an unspoken standard they are failing to meet.
Achiever.overuse: You measure a day by output and struggle to stop, so rest is deferred until it becomes exhaustion.

Activator.name: Activator
Activator.tagline: Turns ideas into immediate action; impatient with endless deliberation.
Activator.description: You are a catalyst who believes that action is the best teacher. You bring energy and momentum to stalled discussions by making decisions and putting ideas into motion immediately.
Activator.action_tip: Partner with analytical colleagues who can evaluate risks while you provide the initial execution thrust.
Activator.shadow: To careful colleagues your bias for starting looks like impatience with thinking.
Activator.overuse: You launch before the problem is understood and spend the time you saved twice over on rework.

Adaptability.name: Adaptability
Adaptability.tagline: Thrives in dynamic ambiguity, living in the moment and responding flexibly.
Adaptability.description: You live in the present and gracefully navigate unexpected disruptions. You view change as a natural opportunity to adjust course and remain composed when sudden pivots occur.
Adaptability.action_tip: Position yourself in fast-moving, evolving roles where rapid troubleshooting and flexibility are paramount.
Adaptability.shadow: People who plan can experience your flexibility as unreliability about commitments.
Adaptability.overuse: You bend to whatever arrives and your own priorities quietly disappear from the week.

Analytical.name: Analytical
Analytical.tagline: Demands proof, uncovers root causes, and insists on objective logic.
Analytical.description: You search for reasons, patterns, and empirical evidence. You challenge unvetted claims, examine underlying data, and bring rigorous objectivity to decision-making processes.
Analytical.action_tip: Present data in structured, accessible visual formats to help non-analytical colleagues digest your findings.
Analytical.shadow: Your questions can land as scepticism aimed at the person rather than the claim.
Analytical.overuse: You ask for one more piece of evidence until the decision window closes without you in it.

Arranger.name: Arranger
Arranger.tagline: Master coordinator who organizes resources and people for maximum efficiency.
Arranger.description: You excel at managing dynamic variables and orchestrating complex moving pieces into optimal configurations. You enjoy reorganizing workflows to find the smoothest path to success.
Arranger.action_tip: Take ownership of multi-stakeholder project logistics and operational workflow optimizations.
Arranger.shadow: Others may feel rearranged rather than consulted when you optimise around them.
Arranger.overuse: You reconfigure so often that the team never settles long enough to get good at anything.

Belief.name: Belief
Belief.tagline: Driven by enduring core values, ethical integrity, and meaningful purpose.
Belief.description: You possess deeply held foundational values that give direction and purpose to your life and work. You inspire trust through uncompromising integrity and passion for mission-driven work.
Belief.action_tip: Align yourself with organizations and projects whose mission genuinely mirrors your core values.
Belief.shadow: Colleagues who reason from tradeoffs can find your convictions hard to negotiate with.
Belief.overuse: A values clash becomes a position you cannot climb down from without feeling you betrayed yourself.

Command.name: Command
Command.tagline: Natural presence, decisive authority, and willingness to lead through crisis.
Command.description: You take charge effortlessly and bring clarity to ambiguous or chaotic situations. You are comfortable with confrontation, speaking candid truth, and making tough calls when others hesitate.
Command.action_tip: Use your strong presence to advocate for team resources and provide steady reassurance during crises.
Command.shadow: Your directness reads as steamrolling to anyone who needed a moment to find their words.
Command.overuse: You take the room so reliably that quieter people stop offering the information you needed.

Communication.name: Communication
Communication.tagline: Brings ideas to life through engaging storytelling, dialogue, and clarity.
Communication.description: You have a natural gift for turning abstract concepts into vivid, inspiring words. You connect with audiences through storytelling, humor, and clear, energetic articulation.
Communication.action_tip: Serve as the spokesperson for key team initiatives, presentations, and stakeholder pitches.
Communication.shadow: People can suspect the story is doing work the substance has not earned.
Communication.overuse: You talk an idea into existence and mistake having explained it for having done it.

Competition.name: Competition
Competition.tagline: Measures progress against peers, energized by winning and raising the bar.
Competition.description: You benchmark your capabilities against top performers and thrive in competitive environments. You are invigorated by challenges where tangible victory and visible excellence can be achieved.
Competition.action_tip: Channel your competitive drive into team wins, setting new performance benchmarks for your group.
Competition.shadow: Teammates may feel measured against you rather than working alongside you.
Competition.overuse: You pick contests you can win and avoid the work where you would look ordinary.

Connectedness.name: Connectedness
Connectedness.tagline: Sees links between all people, events, and phenomena; holistic perspective.
Connectedness.description: You have faith in the interconnectedness of all things. You help teams see the larger meaning behind their work, bridging divides between diverse groups through shared purpose.
Connectedness.action_tip: Facilitate cross-departmental collaboration by helping different teams understand how their goals align.
Connectedness.shadow: Concrete colleagues can hear your framing as vague or impossible to argue with.
Connectedness.overuse: Everything relates to everything, and the specific decision in front of you never gets isolated.

Consistency.name: Consistency
Consistency.tagline: Champions fairness, clear rules, and equitable standards for everyone.
Consistency.description: You are deeply attuned to the importance of treating people fairly and establishing clear, uniform standards. You eliminate favoritism and build stable, transparent rules of engagement.
Consistency.action_tip: Design standard operating procedures and evaluation frameworks that safeguard organizational fairness.
Consistency.shadow: Insisting on the same rule for everyone can feel like indifference to circumstances.
Consistency.overuse: You defend a fair process past the point where it is producing an unfair outcome.

Context.name: Context
Context.tagline: Looks to the past to understand the present and make wiser future decisions.
Context.description: You understand the present by examining historical context and blueprints. You ask how past precedents evolved to uncover foundational lessons and prevent repeating mistakes.
Context.action_tip: Document project retrospectives and case studies to preserve institutional knowledge.
Context.shadow: Forward-looking colleagues can experience your history as resistance to change.
Context.overuse: You relitigate how the situation arose instead of deciding what to do about it now.

Deliberative.name: Deliberative
Deliberative.tagline: Vigilant risk assessor who anticipates obstacles and protects the team.
Deliberative.description: You approach decisions with careful vigilance, identifying risks and obstacles before they emerge. You provide cautious, thoughtful stewardship that prevents costly missteps.
Deliberative.action_tip: Serve as the risk-evaluation lead on strategic proposals, providing realistic mitigation plans.
Deliberative.shadow: Your caution can be read as pessimism, or as a lack of confidence in the team.
Deliberative.overuse: You identify risks so thoroughly that acting stops looking like a viable option at all.

Developer.name: Developer
Developer.tagline: Spots potential in others and derives joy from cultivating their growth.
Developer.description: You see the dormant capabilities in people and take immense satisfaction in witnessing their progress. You are a natural mentor who encourages incremental improvements.
Developer.action_tip: Take on mentorship and onboarding responsibilities, providing structured feedback that boosts confidence.
Developer.shadow: Your attention to someone's potential can feel like being treated as a project.
Developer.overuse: You keep investing in people who are not improving, and carry work that was theirs to do.

Discipline.name: Discipline
Discipline.tagline: Craves structure, precision schedules, predictability, and orderly execution.
Discipline.description: You bring order to chaos through disciplined planning, structured timelines, and clear routines. You break long-term projects into manageable, time-bound milestones.
Discipline.action_tip: Create project roadmaps, checklists, and delivery schedules that keep teams on time and aligned.
Discipline.shadow: Your need for structure looks like rigidity to people who work in bursts.
Discipline.overuse: The system becomes the point, and you defend the routine after its reason has gone.

Empathy.name: Empathy
Empathy.tagline: Deeply senses others emotions, creates psychological safety and understanding.
Empathy.description: You intuitively perceive the emotions and unexpressed needs of those around you. You create an atmosphere of psychological safety, authentic listening, and mutual support.
Empathy.action_tip: Help leaders gauge team morale and serve as a trusted sounding board for colleagues.
Empathy.shadow: Others may feel read before they were ready to be known.
Empathy.overuse: You absorb the room's feelings until you can no longer tell which of them are yours.

Focus.name: Focus
Focus.tagline: Maintains clear priorities, eliminates distractions, and stays on target.
Focus.description: You establish a clear trajectory and ruthlessly filter out distractions. You constantly evaluate whether current activities contribute to the primary destination.
Focus.action_tip: Set non-negotiable priority blocks in your schedule and help teams align on weekly focus objectives.
Focus.shadow: Your filtering can look like dismissiveness toward anything you have judged irrelevant.
Focus.overuse: You hold the original goal past the point where the evidence changed and the goal should have.

Futuristic.name: Futuristic
Futuristic.tagline: Inspired by possibilities, envisioning what could be and inspiring progress.
Futuristic.description: You are energized by tomorrow. You paint vivid pictures of future innovations, products, and possibilities that motivate and uplift those working toward long-term goals.
Futuristic.action_tip: Lead visionary strategy workshops and articulate future horizons during quarterly roadmaps.
Futuristic.shadow: People inside today's problems can hear your horizon as an escape from present work.
Futuristic.overuse: You are three versions ahead while the current one ships without you.

Harmony.name: Harmony
Harmony.tagline: Seeks consensus, diffuses friction, and builds collaborative common ground.
Harmony.description: You look for points of agreement and reduce unnecessary conflict. You believe that collaboration thrives when people find common ground and work together cooperatively.
Harmony.action_tip: Mediate cross-functional disagreements by redirecting focus toward shared, overarching goals.
Harmony.shadow: Your search for common ground can feel like the real disagreement is being suppressed.
Harmony.overuse: Conflict goes underground unresolved and resurfaces later as something worse.

Ideation.name: Ideation
Ideation.tagline: Fascinated by ideas, spotting unexpected connections and creative angles.
Ideation.description: You are a creative concept generator who connects seemingly unrelated concepts to create novel solutions. You bring fresh perspectives that challenge conventional wisdom.
Ideation.action_tip: Lead brainstorming and rapid ideation sessions when teams encounter stubborn, complex challenges.
Ideation.shadow: Executors can experience a stream of new ideas as churn that resets their work.
Ideation.overuse: The interesting part ends at the concept, and finishing feels like a chore for someone else.

Includer.name: Includer
Includer.tagline: Welcoming spirit who expands the circle so no one feels left out.
Includer.description: You are naturally sensitive to those on the perimeter. You expand team circles, invite diverse voices into discussions, and ensure everyone feels seen and included.
Includer.action_tip: Champion inclusive collaboration and foster welcome rituals for new team members.
Includer.shadow: Widening the circle can feel to those already in it like decisions slowing to a crawl.
Includer.overuse: Everyone is in the room and no one is accountable for the call.

Individualization.name: Individualization
Individualization.tagline: Appreciates unique human differences, tailoring approaches to each person.
Individualization.description: You see each person as an individual with distinct strengths, styles, and motivations. You excel at configuring customized teams where each person plays to their natural genius.
Individualization.action_tip: Advise managers on role assignments and customized motivation strategies for team members.
Individualization.shadow: Tailoring to each person can look like inconsistency or favouritism from outside.
Individualization.overuse: You carry so much bespoke handling that nothing about the team scales.

Input.name: Input
Input.tagline: Voracious collector of knowledge, resources, frameworks, and insights.
Input.description: You crave information and love archiving useful articles, tools, and ideas. You serve as an intellectual resource hub for your peers whenever specialized knowledge is needed.
Input.action_tip: Curate a centralized knowledge base or resource library for your organization.
Input.shadow: Colleagues may find your collecting hard to distinguish from delay.
Input.overuse: You gather more than you will ever use, and the reading substitutes for the deciding.

Intellection.name: Intellection
Intellection.tagline: Introspective deep thinker who enjoys theoretical exploration and reflection.
Intellection.description: You appreciate deep mental activity, introspection, and philosophical inquiry. You take time to reflect, synthesizing complex concepts into coherent mental models.
Intellection.action_tip: Schedule dedicated quiet thinking blocks for deep conceptual work and strategy refinement.
Intellection.shadow: Your thinking time reads as disengagement to people waiting on a reply.
Intellection.overuse: You refine internally, and the team never gets the benefit because it never leaves your head.

Learner.name: Learner
Learner.tagline: Energized by mastering new skills and continuous intellectual growth.
Learner.description: You possess an insatiable desire to learn and master new topics. You are invigorated by the journey from novice to competent practitioner across emerging domains.
Learner.action_tip: Embrace emerging technology pilots and pioneer training initiatives to upskill your team.
Learner.shadow: Your pull toward the new can look like boredom with the work you already own.
Learner.overuse: You keep arriving at competence and leaving before the value gets captured.

Maximizer.name: Maximizer
Maximizer.tagline: Focuses on transforming great into superb; obsessed with excellence.
Maximizer.description: You focus on taking strong capabilities and elevating them to world-class mastery. You prefer refining strengths rather than obsessing over average weaknesses.
Maximizer.action_tip: Focus on high-leverage initiatives where moving from good to great generates massive returns.
Maximizer.shadow: People whose work is adequate can feel judged for not being excellent.
Maximizer.overuse: Good enough is never allowed to be finished, and the last ten percent eats the schedule.

Positivity.name: Positivity
Positivity.tagline: Contagious enthusiasm, upbeat optimism, and uplifting team morale.
Positivity.description: You bring an infectious energy and optimistic outlook that brightens workplaces. You help teams maintain hope, celebrate wins, and see the silver lining during stressful times.
Positivity.action_tip: Inject energy into team kickoffs and lead recognition rituals that celebrate collective effort.
Positivity.shadow: Optimism can feel dismissive to someone whose problem is genuinely bad.
Positivity.overuse: Bad news gets softened until nobody, including you, has an accurate picture.

Relator.name: Relator
Relator.tagline: Finds deep satisfaction in building close, authentic, trust-based bonds.
Relator.description: You prefer deep, genuine, and authentic relationships over superficial acquaintances. You forge deep bonds of mutual trust with colleagues and work hardest alongside trusted peers.
Relator.action_tip: Build trusted core partnerships and collaborate closely with key colleagues over long horizons.
Relator.shadow: Your preference for depth can leave newer colleagues feeling outside the circle.
Relator.overuse: You invest only where trust already exists, and your reach quietly narrows over time.

Responsibility.name: Responsibility
Responsibility.tagline: Takes absolute psychological ownership of commitments and promises.
Responsibility.description: You take immense personal ownership of every commitment you make. Your reputation for impeccable dependability means people trust you unconditionally to deliver.
Responsibility.action_tip: Protect your bandwidth by learning to say no to lower-priority requests so you never overcommit.
Responsibility.shadow: Your ownership can crowd out other people's and make delegation feel like doubt.
Responsibility.overuse: You say yes to everything you touch until the commitments exceed what one person can hold.

Restorative.name: Restorative
Restorative.tagline: Loves diagnosing breakdowns, troubleshooting problems, and fixing issues.
Restorative.description: You are energized by diagnosing what is broken, solving intricate problems, and restoring vitality to struggling projects, systems, or workflows.
Restorative.action_tip: Volunteer to tackle turnaround projects, legacy code refactoring, and workflow rescue operations.
Restorative.shadow: A focus on what is broken can feel to others like their work is being audited.
Restorative.overuse: You are drawn to problems, and the healthy parts of the system never get your attention.

Self-Assurance.name: Self-Assurance
Self-Assurance.tagline: Inner confidence, certainty in judgment, and willingness to take bold risks.
Self-Assurance.description: You possess a deep internal compass and trust your instincts. You feel confident taking calculated risks and navigating uncharted territory with poise and resolve.
Self-Assurance.action_tip: Step forward to lead high-stakes, novel initiatives where clear precedent does not yet exist.
Self-Assurance.shadow: Certainty can read as not having heard the objection.
Self-Assurance.overuse: You trust your judgment in domains where you have no evidence, and confidence outruns competence.

Significance.name: Significance
Significance.tagline: Driven to make a major mark, stand out, and achieve high-visibility impact.
Significance.description: You want your work to be meaningful and widely recognized. You are motivated by high-visibility projects that allow you to make a profound, memorable impact on the world.
Significance.action_tip: Seek out leadership roles on flagship initiatives that align with your desire for major impact.
Significance.shadow: Your need for the work to matter can look like a need to be seen doing it.
Significance.overuse: You choose visible work over necessary work, and the unglamorous essentials go undone.

Strategic.name: Strategic
Strategic.tagline: Quickly spots patterns, cuts through clutter, and selects the best pathway.
Strategic.description: You effortlessly anticipate alternative scenarios and ask what if. You sort through complexity, spot patterns that others miss, and choose the most effective path forward.
Strategic.action_tip: Lead strategic roadmap planning and advise leadership on contingency scenarios.
Strategic.shadow: Arriving at the best path quickly can leave others unsure how you got there.
Strategic.overuse: You see the route so fast that you stop explaining it, and no one can follow or challenge you.

Woo.name: Woo
Woo.tagline: Wins others over; enjoys breaking the ice and connecting with new people.
Woo.description: You love the thrill of meeting strangers, breaking the ice, and establishing instant rapport. You expand social circles rapidly and make newcomers feel immediately comfortable.
Woo.action_tip: Lead business development, external networking, and client ambassador initiatives.
Woo.shadow: Ease with new people can read as shallow to those who value depth.
Woo.overuse: You keep opening new connections, and few of them become relationships that owe you anything.
